content.comment_body: I have a 4-20 mA signal from a sensor powered by a separate power supply in another cabinet. The power supplies for the sensor and the [product_name] analog module are isolated. Will analog inputs on the [product_name] module work under these conditions? Is it necessary for the power supply for the [product_name] module and the sensor power supply to share a common connection? I searched for documentation explaining the specific terminals on the module – labeled I1, M1, and U1 per channel – but couldn't find any clear explanation. What do these labels mean, and which terminals should I use for the sensor wires? Thanks!

Hello! I1 is used with current-type sensors, U1 is for voltage-type sensors, M1 is the common terminal. To minimize issues, it's generally best to keep the same electrical potential in your system. Also, review this reference: [url] See page 37 for wiring details for the [product_name] module. Hope this clarifies things!
